slow.text: 카드… 여기 넣어요. 그리고… 만 원, 눌러요.

gloss.en: Card... put it here. Then... press ten thousand won.
Put the card in. Press 10,000 won.

cash.text: 이 기계는 현금만 돼요. 현금 있어요?

gloss.en: This machine only takes cash. Do you have cash?
There's an ATM at the convenience store over there.
The convenience store has an ATM.
There, done. 10,000 won has been added.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
Over there on the right. Let's go together.

setting: Leaving a Korean evening class at a community centre in Gwangju. A classmate, Ye-rin, walks out with the learner and chats for a minute.

goal.en: Say no, you have a part-time job now.
Say sorry, you don't have time today.
Ask her to say the day again.
Say OK, you got it.
Say great, let's go.
Say goodbye.

hello.text: 오늘 수업 어려웠어요. 지금 집에 가요?

gloss.en: Class was hard today. Are you going home now?

where.text: 아, 그래요? 저는 지금 도서관에 가요.

gloss.en: Oh, really? I'm going to the library now.
Let's study together. Do you have time?
Do you have time? Or not?

next.text: 괜찮아요. 다음 수업은 목요일 일곱 시예요.

gloss.en: That's OK. The next class is Thursday at seven.
See you Thursday then. Get home safe!
